# Spell Name

## Description

Write one Friends & Fables-ready description in 900–1000 characters without going over. Include visual identity, action timing, target, duration, restrictions, scaling, special interactions, and unsupported mechanics here.

Use a numeric **Range**. Use `0` for self-only effects. Use turn-based durations. Friends & Fables does not use concentration; state any disruption check directly in the description.

Do not repeat attack damage dice, flat attack modifiers, formal damage type, attack-roll type, save stat, or save damage percentages when dedicated fields exist. If a damaging spell has **Is Attack:** No, include its damage in the description.
